passRequirements.identity: pinned assignment and exact set membership
passRequirements.rawInventory: all original rows/fields retained, not semantic equivalence
passRequirements.mappingSemantics: reviewed lossless annotation/variant policy and actual exact lookup
passRequirements.sameFontSvg: same contract and equal canonical vector structure
passRequirements.sameFontPixels: same contract, rasterizer and locked tolerances
passRequirements.browsers: actual versioned environment evidence for each required browser/platform

noRegression: Prior pass becoming anything else or deleted case blocks; immutable expected-known anchors may not be weakened to pass
